input.quote: 28.1 This Agreement is governed exclusively by Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction.
input.rationale: Section 28.1 imposes Singapore law and exclusive Singapore jurisdiction — a foreign forum outside the accepted list (New York, Delaware, California, England and Wales), which is walk-away territory and also contradicts the exclusive New York County venue already agreed in 28.2. The shortest cure is to change the governing law in 28.1 to New York; the preferred venue element is already satisfied verbatim by 28.2, and deleting the conflicting Singapore forum words removes the dangling conflict. Section 28.3 escalation is unaffected.

mappings.element: New York law governs the Agreement.
State and federal courts in New York County have exclusive jurisdiction.
mappings.quote: The state and federal courts located in New York County, New York have exclusive jurisdiction

proposal.summary: Replace Singapore governing law and exclusive Singapore jurisdiction with New York law, leaving the New York County venue in 28.2 to operate.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We require New York governing law, so we have replaced the Singapore law and exclusive Singapore courts in 28.1, which also conflicted with the New York County venue already agreed in 28.2. Delaware, California or England and Wales law with the corresponding courts would be our fallback.

ops.oldText: governed exclusively by Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction
ops.newText: governed by the laws of the State of New York
